title: Thermostable chaperone-based polypeptide biosynthesis: Enfuvirtide model product quality and protocol-related impurities

what_it_measured.text: Enfuvirtide, the largest therapeutic peptide used in HIV infection treatment, was synthesized in our thermostable chaperone-based peptide biosynthesis system and evaluated for peptide quality as well as the profile of process-related impurities.

endpoint.text: Host cell proteins (HCPs) and BrCN cleavage-modified peptides were evaluated by LC-MS in intermediate. Cleavage modifications during the reaction were assessed after LC-MS maps were aligned by simple in-house algorithm and formylation/oxidation levels were estimated. Circular dichroism spectra of the obtained enfuvirtide were compared to the those of the chemically- synthesized standard product.

reported_results.text: HCP level in final product was 5.58 ppm and bacterial endotoxin level less than 1.06 EU/ mg was measured.
